items.title: Bob Hardaway interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 14, 1999
items.q: Anyway he gave my father his first job

ctx.x: And he also is the one that put together the Mr. Lincoln display I guess you’d call it, at Disneyland, where they have a thing, it’s a dummy that looks like Lincoln, and it does the Gettysburg Address with motions and all. He figured that one out way, way back. At any rate he eventually became the head of the special effects department at Disney, and he passed away quite some time ago.
